=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1220-1225 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `push_preflight_status` is `blocked` for `checkout_guard_unpushable`, the workflow skips `exit 1` and continues into the expensive reviewer/editor phases.
  WHY: All reviewers agreed this defeats the fail-fast preflight gate and wastes compute/tokens on a run that cannot successfully push.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1156-1157 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `non_fast_forward` is treated as a definitive unpushable reason in `is_definitive_unpushable_reason()`.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is a recoverable concurrent-push condition that the workflow’s existing fetch/merge retry path is meant to handle, so classifying it as blocked causes false failures.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1117-1120 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The preflight pushability gate no longer explicitly sets `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this may break `git push --dry-run` authentication in some repository/auth configurations and can produce false blocked results, though the impact is edge-case dependent.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:66-69 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup assertion was weakened from an exact-count check to `count >= 1`.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is a test strictness regression rather than a runtime bug, but it reduces protection against duplicate or stray cleanup occurrences.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1178-1181 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Wrapping the dry-run probe in `timeout 30s` may leave git lock files behind if it interrupts the command.
  WHY: This was only raised by one reviewer as a hardening concern, with low confidence and no corroboration from the others.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1211-1216 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The credential redaction regex may miss some custom token or proxy URL formats.
  WHY: This was a single-reviewer hardening suggestion only, so it remains separate from the consensus bugs.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1223 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not exit when `push_preflight_status` is `blocked` for `checkout_guard_unpushable`.
  WHY: The reviewer said this violates the fail-fast intent and lets expensive reviewer/editor work run even when push is known to be impossible.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1157 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `non_fast_forward` is classified as a definitive unpushable reason.
  WHY: The reviewer said the workflow already has retry logic for this recoverable push race, so treating it as definitive causes premature failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1118-1120 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Removing explicit `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` may break authentication for `git push --dry-run`.
  WHY: The reviewer said some repository/auth setups may still require explicit token exposure, so the probe could fail with false blocked status.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:69 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The cleanup assertion was relaxed from an exact count to `count >= 1`.
  WHY: The reviewer said this weakens the test and allows duplicate or stray cleanup commands to go unnoticed.
